tools.description: Use this when someone asks what is showing in one area tonight, tomorrow, this weekend or on a date. tools.name: scenef_search_showtimes
tools.description: Showtimes scoped by FILM or by THEATER on one board — pass at least one. tools.description: One theater's card: address, neighborhood, website, ticketing note, structured discounts (label/detail/day; membership and discount-card pricing reads "Member pricing; see the theater"), amenities, its next 5 showtimes with ticket links, and its calendar feed url. tools.description: The card for one film on one board: title, year, runtime, genres, directors, cast, overview, rating, a trailer url and a TMDB poster url when present, its upcoming showtimes nearest first with venue/time/ticket link, and a last-night flag when the run is ending. tools.name: scenef_plan_movie_night
tools.description: Suggests 2-4 movie-night options on one board from a window and a taste profile — film + specific showtime + theater + why it fits — plus one wildcard: the highest-ranked film outside the stated genres, or the next film down when no genre is stated. time_after/time_before are hard bounds; genres and

tools.name: scenef_discounts
tools.description: Every structured discount across one board's theaters — venue, label, detail, and day-bound days — with the ones that apply today flagged. Membership and discount-card pricing is not listed; it reads "Member pricing; see the theater". Read-only: the call itself records nothing.

tools.name: scenef_coming_soon
tools.description: Lists films whose first screening on this board is more than 48 hours out, sorted by first night. Configurable horizon. It sets no alert, watch or reminder. tools.description: Translate a city, 5-digit ZIP, neighborhood or board alias into the region handle every other tool takes. Returns the board and WHAT matched it.
